title: Privacy concern: Claude Code appears to take screenshots without clear disclosure
body:
## Description
When viewing Claude's summary of fixes/changes and navigating to the text in the editor, macOS displays a screenshot indicator, suggesting Claude Code is capturing the screen. These screenshots don't appear on my desktop, which raises concerns they may be transmitted to Claude servers.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Have Claude make code changes and provide a summary
2. Click/navigate to the summary text in the editor
3. Observe macOS screenshot notification/indicator

## Expected Behavior
- Clear documentation about when and why screenshots are captured
- User control over screenshot capture
- Explicit consent before capturing screen content

## Environment
- OS: macOS (Darwin 25.1.0)
- Claude Code version: Latest

## Privacy Concerns
- Where are these screenshots being sent?
- What data is being collected?
- How can users disable this feature?
- Why isn't this documented in the privacy policy?

## Request
Please clarify:
1. Is this intended behavior?
2. What permissions does Claude Code require and why?
3. How can users opt out?
author: ravituringworks
